decision: voided by the team (operator decision, 31 Oct 2026); disclosed in CLAUDE.md
what_happened: While hand-checking the Step 3 agent tools, a notebook cell meant to show finalize() refusing a failed run was given the killed tool-check run m-eurosat-0005 instead (the intended out-of-memory run was rejected at launch and the notebook picked the most recent run id). finalize accepted killed runs, so the m-eurosat test split was evaluated once.
impact: Test accuracy 0.895 of a throwaway 5-epoch ResNet18 was observed. No model, config or decision was chosen using it. m-eurosat will be finalized once more, with a model selected on validation only; that later test score must be reported together with this incident.
fixes: tool checks run in a sandbox workspace (GOTRAIN_WORKSPACE) where finalize/final_test refuse
check notebook takes run ids from launch results and stops on unexpected results
